findings.title: Palestinian man succumbs to wounds sustained in Israeli strike on displacement tent in Gaza
findings.location: Sheikh Radwan neighborhood, northern Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: 28-year-old Palestinian Abdullah Mazen Hassouna; displaced civilians sheltered in a tent
findings.incident_type: new fatality from injuries sustained in a tent strike several days earlier
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A Palestinian man died on Sunday from wounds sustained in an Israeli airstrike on northern Gaza City.
findings.source_type: established Palestinian news agency citing unnamed medical sources; English and Arabic versions are same source, not independent corroboration

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: WAFA English and Arabic latest-news direct read after OCHA OPT and WHO checks and twelve targeted searches
bounded_discovery_context.distinction: Newly reported death, not a newly occurring airstrike. Sheikh Radwan/Gaza City and named decedent are distinct from previously recorded al-Mawasi/Khan Younis, al-Saftawi/Jabalia and Rafah events.
bounded_discovery_context.corroboration: WAFA English and original Arabic versions agree; medical source unnamed; independent external corroboration not established.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: Exact time of death and date of original strike not specified in the report.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary bounded recall watch only; primary daily Gaza publisher/collector remains authoritative.

official_first_checks.detail: Homepage current Gaza updates dated 13 Nov; no newly dated in-window entry.

Official overview checked. No fresh interval-specific hospital, ambulance, capacity, medical-evacuation or health update.
Static headline Health Cluster figures as of September 2026; no new confirmed operational change.
Persisting, previously recorded HTTP 502; alternative WHO Global and Health Cluster sources checked. Initial noncanonical WHO conflict URL returned 404 and canonical URL was used.

direct_source_checks.detail: 11:50 AM Gaza-local 15 Nov death from wounds; source article https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/176944
Original report at 11:48 AM Palestine local corroborates WAFA's English publication but is not independent.

Al-Mawasi 1 killed, 2 wounded is already recorded. Additional reported explosives on homes/tents near Beit Lahia lacked independently verified casualties, damage, precise time or separate confirmation.
Samir Abu Younis commander killing linked to Nov 14 incident, already considered; no new documented civilian impact verified.

excluded_candidates: Al-Mawasi Khan Younis displaced-tent strike killing one and injuring two: prior positive ledger heartbeat Nov 14 afternoon; later Nov 15 coverage repeats incident.
Samir Abu Younis death in Nov 14 Israeli strike: considered by previous watch; no distinct new civilian casualty confirmed.

Anadolu account of Beit Lahia drone explosives targeting homes and displaced tents and northern shelling: timing, injuries and physical impact unverified, local sources unnamed; retained as non-qualifying lead.
Older Jabalia/Al-Saftawi fatalities, Rafah delayed death, Nasser Medical Complex strike, Nov 6–9 flooding, aid and food/water shortages: previously known or outside interval.
West Bank and diplomatic statements without implemented Gaza crossing, aid or ceasefire changes.
scope_categories_checked: military operations with documented civilian impact
coverage_gaps: WHO EMRO OPT returned an established HTTP 502; alternative WHO official sources accessible.
Some articles provide only publication date, not time, and publication indexing lags real events; the negative checks do not establish that no other events occurred.
coverage_notes.limitation: A newly recorded death from earlier injury is distinct from its older strike. Attribution and death relied on WAFA quoting unnamed medical sources without independent confirmation.
